**M5/M8 surface map: PR #739 boundary debt merged with no code, ADR-0024 vs #323 supersede tension**

**What**: Produced a precise map of the current surface M5 (#312 role-as-port) and M8 (#323 stage->engine map) must build on, for a 2026-08-20 handoff.
**Why**: 2026-08-17 handoff measured M5 at zero implementation; this pass re-verified and extended to collisions.
**Where**: brain/scripts/harness/cli.mjs (VALID_OPS=['init'] still, line 99), brain/scripts/harness/backends/*.mjs (4 backends: plain/gentle-ai/claude/antigravity, none declare model_tier/tools/reads/writes — n=0 not n=1), brain/scripts/lib/sdd-layout.mjs:68 (REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS frozen, 9 consumers via rg), brain/scripts/bootstrap.sh:277 (SDD_ENGINE default gentle-ai), brain.config.json (no harness/stage/engine keys), brain/core/config-migrations.mjs (declares nothing for harness/engine/stage — confirms #643's dead-code claim about platformConfig's harness branch in agent-runtime.mjs:206-211), ADR-0019 (adr-0019-harness-port.md, rejects expanding VALID_OPS per-backend AND rejects treating single-init as ceiling), draft ADR-0023 (brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md, unratified, extends not supersedes ADR-0019), ADR-0024 (adr-0024-three-axis-decoupling.md:53-55, explicitly says stage->engine map "would require its own ADR superseding ADR-0019's single-lifecycle decision" — accepted ADR text says SUPERSEDE), while #323's own issue body argues it may only need a narrow amendment to ADR-0019's first rejected alternative and says "decide this explicitly in design.md, do not assume the supersede" — this is a live tension between an already-Accepted ADR's stated consequence and the ticket's own reasoning.
**Learned**: PR #739 (merged 2026-08-20, same day as this research) recorded the "M5 boundary debt" in openspec design.md for #682 (reviewer.inferential.challenger.{axis,agent,model}) but shipped ZERO code — `resolve-challenger.mjs` does not exist on main (fd found nothing), only design.md/tasks.md changed. So the collision is documented/provisional, not yet materialized — the debt is a future deletion obligation on #312, not present duplicate code. Also: issue #576 (step B, first-party role set) was filed without checking M5 and had to be rescoped as "step B of M5" after maintainer correction — the archetype taxonomy (Coordinator/Constructor/Adversary/Verifier) survives but write-surface/blindness fields collapse onto #312's writes/reads fields. Issue #312's own comment thread found the SDD action set is not data anywhere in the codebase (sdd-explore appears once as a help string) — the contract's primary key doesn't exist yet, which is why the maintainer ruling reordered dependency to #312(port)->#323(map)->#456(stage set), with #456 being where the stage set becomes configurable data at all, not just where custom stages get accepted.
